text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, now that we've made it this far...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship!! You're not getting away!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're still chasing me!? You're as 
relentless as a Komodo dragon...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be a frilled lizard! I'm 
definitely gonna outrun you~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: See ya!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*. You were here...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I would've appreciated it if you'd read 
the situation and at least stalled them a 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It's fine, don't apologize. I was just 
venting and taking it out on you. ...My 
bad."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... What a troublesome matter. As 
the student council, we cannot overlook 
improper conduct off-campus, but—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"To think I have to chase an opponent who 
runs away so wildly with only sixty 
percent of my strength."
choice_data_list: Going all out would be bad, right?
It'd be bad to go all out, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Umamusume are strictly 
prohibited from sprinting outside of 
designated zones.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When we sprint at full speed, we easily 
exceed 50 km/h. An accidental collision 
would result in a terrible accident.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, times like this can be really 
frustrating..."
choice_data_list: How about calling in some backup?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, times like this can be really 
frustrating..."
choice_data_list: How about calling in some backup?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. You cannot even catch up when I run 
at sixty percent of my strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even at full sprint, you wouldn't even 
catch the tip of her tail."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A strategy, you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho... you claim to have an effective 
measure? Very well, let's hear it.

And so, Air Groove and I devised various 
schemes to capture Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Daaaaaammit! Who do they think they 
are?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Didn't your mama teach you that pincer 
attacks in tag are totally lame!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No such rules apply to the speed-walking 
tag matches between me and my mother!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Air Groove and her mom used to play 
some weird game called 'Power-Walking 
Tag'? Sounds pretty fun, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just you wait until we get back to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you piling on unreasonable 
offenses!? Tyranny! Tyranny! Down with the 
Empress's dictatorship~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Shut up!!

...Regardless, I somehow managed to catch 
her in the end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A helper? Gold Ship is our opponent, you 
know. Could there really be someone so 
conveniently suited to the job...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ......No, wait a sec.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There was one person... Someone who could 
actually keep Gold Ship's elusive antics 
in check...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Umm~... Why did you suddenly call me 
here~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that, just stay right there and 
wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yooo, Jordan!! Your back looks as 
slappable as ever today!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah?! Wait, no way! Where'd you even 
come from?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Splendid work, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geh!? A-Air Groove!? Don't tell me... it 
was a trap... !?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You won't get away this time...! Come 
here! I'm going to teach you a thorough 
lesson!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, what a tragedy……! Golshi-chan…… 
R.I.P……"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Huh. What? Wait a sec."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......I don't make sense of this AT ALL~?!

For some reason, I ended up having to calm 
Tosen Jordan down, but—

It seemed that after a brief chase, Air 
Groove managed to catch Gold Ship.
